falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low forming; a close below 4,800 would break the August 2024 structure and invalidate the bottoming thesis, forcing a trend continuation or new low assessment

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained volatility spike above 25 would contradict the BLOWOFF SCORE of 39, which implies complacency/potential exhaustion rather than fear; this would signal the pattern match failed and a capitulation phase is underway instead

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid flight-to-quality bid of this magnitude would indicate recession panic rather than the soft-landing/goldilocks scenario implied by the bottom_2024_aug pattern; the macro regime shift would invalidate the current signal

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
